## Progress

- [StableAffineCover.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/AbelianVarieties/Milne/MilneLib/StableAffineCover.lean): proved finite prime-avoidance/basic-open refinements and `StableGroupAction.exists_stable_affineOpen_of_orbits` via the norm construction (`add2400d2a`, `5df4ddadf4`).
- [AffineQuotientOver.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/AbelianVarieties/Milne/MilneLib/AffineQuotientOver.lean): added the affine quotient bridge in `Over (Spec k)`, with explicit base-compatible factorization and uniqueness (`f4554afc73`).
- [InvariantQuotient.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/AbelianVarieties/Milne/MilneLib/InvariantQuotient.lean): proved quotient/spectrum-action preimage identities for invariant basic opens (`d83c3a9874`, `d813717c6c`).
- [SymmetricPower.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/AbelianVarieties/Milne/MilneLib/SymmetricPower.lean): promoted relative permutations to an `Aut`-valued `S_n` action, transported it to the underlying relative-product scheme, and added a conditional stable-cover corollary (`45b8798b44`).
- Synced hgraph and updated roadmap/task handoff; final scoped ledger is clean.
